text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The little sister is just fine! The little sister is just fine!!
Narita Brian takes first!! First place!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Brian! Brian!!
Brian! Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Chants of 'Brian!' echo through the venue!
That was truly the run of a 'Monster'!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yes... This is it! This is our ideal!
This is Narita Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Lady Brian,
you are so utterly valiant...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You're way too strong as always,
Brian-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...I'm still no match for her.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's only "not yet."
...All right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I have returned.
choice_data_list: Welcome back. Are your legs feeling okay?
Welcome back. Do your legs seem all right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes. Without getting too caught up in the big stage, and without any pain.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'm "not quite ready yet"!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hurry!
Narita Brian's press scrum has already started!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: The advance squad already secured the audio! Word is, they're heading straight down the middle-to-long distance royal road!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
So then, wrap up this year with the Arima Kinen,
and kick off next year with the Tenno Sho (Spring)...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...The Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: By next spring, do you think the concerns with my legs will be resolved?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) is the ultimate showdown for stayers.
Sakura Laurel certainly has the talent for it, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Of course—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —...Or so I'd like to say, but if you give in to your impatience, all your efforts will come to nothing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind if I can't race next year.
Even if it ends up being the year after that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure—that girl
will keep running ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To overtake them, you should challenge them
only when you are fully prepared.
choice_data_list: Got it, then I'll go with that assumption!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will endure the winter
and bloom proudly come spring!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
...! Biwa Hayahide was
discharged from the hospital on schedule!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's awesome!
I mean, see~? There was nothing to worry about after all~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
Brian is doing great too.
After the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
it's finally time for the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text: ...Moving on to our next story.

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
...! We interrupt our scheduled broadcast
to bring you this breaking news.

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news. Biwa Hayahide, who was
running in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
"Having suffered an injury to her left leg,
she announced that 'all future race plans
have been scrapped.'"

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
While a direct showdown with Narita Brian at the Arima Kinen
was highly anticipated,
those plans have now all been canceled.
